name: Control Charts (SPC) and Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)
when_to_use: Process measured repeatedly over time; control charts assess whether the process is stable (common vs. special causes), Cp/Cpk measure whether it is within acceptable specification limits.
notes: Tracks a process over time to see whether it is stable, and measures whether it is within acceptable limits. Applications: industrial quality control, operational indicator monitoring.

expected_input.question: Is the process stable over time, and within acceptable limits?

pdca_use: Direct fit for Check: control charts and Cp/Cpk are the classic SPC instrument for telling whether a process is stable and within specification — same logic as industrial PDCA, 100% deterministic calculation.

plain_explanation.purpose: Tracks a process over time and warns when it leaves its normal behavior.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to monitor ongoing quality or performance.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Successive measurements of the process, in time order.
plain_explanation.example: Watch the daily response time and act when it leaves the band.
